ex: My cousin is working *in China* now.
我表哥現在在中國工作。
This phone case was *made in China*.
這個手機殼是中國製造的。
Grandma serves tea in *a china cup*.
奶奶用瓷杯奉茶。
My aunt bought *a set of china* for her new home.
我阿姨為新家買了一套瓷器。
The school sports day is *in May*.
學校運動會在五月。
Our class trip is in *early May* this year.
我們班今年的校外教學在五月初。

collocs.zh: 陳小姐；陳老師（女老師的稱呼）
ex: *Miss Chen* teaches us English on Mondays.
陳老師每週一教我們英文。
Hurry up, or we will *miss the bus*.
快一點，不然我們會錯過公車。
I *missed a class* because I was sick.
我因為生病缺了一堂課。
I really *miss my grandparents* in Tainan.
我好想念住在台南的爺爺奶奶。
*May I* use the bathroom, please?
請問我可以去上廁所嗎？
The bus is late, so we *may as well* walk.
公車誤點了，我們不如走路吧。
That *may be* the right answer, but check again.
那可能是正確答案，但再檢查一次。
